name: RMIT Humanitarian Visa Scholarship
summary: $5,000 a year for refugee students at RMIT who hold a Permanent Humanitarian Visa.
key: $5,000 a year full-time, or $2,500 part-time, for the standard program length. Five offered.
who: Holds a current Australian Permanent Humanitarian Visa and not Australian citizenship.
A current refugee starting or continuing at RMIT Melbourne in Semester 1 2027.
how: Apply direct to RMIT online (preferred) or through VTAC, with supporting documents.

evidence.quote: $5,000 per year ($2,500 per semester) for full-time enrolled
